title: Test Goldens
summary: Record-or-compare value banks for tests, so a watched number lives in a text file beside the test and is re-recorded by one command instead of being hand-edited in test source.
dependencies: a C test runner for the native half (Unity in this studio)
GAME_GOLDENS_DIR supplied by the game test runner
provides: test_golden_u64 / test_golden_i64 / test_golden_f64 / test_golden_text for C tests
shared key = value bank format for both halves

flags.record: GAME_UPDATE_GOLDENS=1 switches every helper from compare to record
flags.location: GAME_GOLDENS_DIR points at the bank directory; defaults to tests/goldens
